name: seekwide
description: Site audits you can re-run and trust: a polite crawler, scripted SEO, link and Core Web Vitals checks with evidence, repeatable scores and a client-ready report.

report_brand_name.title: Report brand name
report_brand_name.description: Shown as "Prepared by" on audit reports. Leave empty for unbranded reports.

report_logo_path.title: Report logo file
report_logo_path.description: Absolute path to a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG file of 200 KB or less, shown on audit reports. Leave empty for no logo.

google_api_key.title: Google API key
google_api_key.description: Optional. Used to measure Core Web Vitals with Google's PageSpeed Insights API and Chrome UX Report API; enable both for the key's Google Cloud project. The key is sent only to those two APIs. Without it, real-user data is not collected and Google usually refuses the lab test.
